findings.finding: Directly focusing Model and modal choices did not prove keyboard reachability.
findings.resolution: Both test and native runner now reach these controls with Tab, asserting actual focus and compositor visibility.

Test now asserts complete section values and allowed deletions. Empty deletion map was rejected because the existing credential-source contract intentionally removes inactive credential keys. Native runner checks full parsed config equality against the intended mutation.

findings.finding: Native runner assumed seed values without a clear preflight.
findings.resolution: Explicit seed provider/model/endpoint validation before app construction.

findings.finding: Re-entry should not be presented as restart verification.
findings.resolution: Documentation qualifies same-process navigation; disk persistence is directly read but process restart is not tested.
